---
title: "Data Explorer Summary Panel"
---

The summary panel describes the selected column. Depending on its type, the panel can show counts, missing values, ranges, distributions, frequencies, or other statistics supplied by the runtime.

Select another column to update the summary. Results can be approximate or limited when the provider avoids transferring an entire large data set.

Use the panel to spot quality issues and unusual distributions, then calculate and record definitive statistics in project code.
